title: Continuous Wraparound Corner Window Wall
description: One newly authored whole L-shaped village wall with a single continuous unglazed opening that wraps the right-angle building corner. The lower wall and upper return lintel remain continuous around the corner, while no intermediate corner post divides the aperture. Two full-height end piers connect the complete lower and upper wall returns into one closed editable material solid. The window sill and soffit are actual thick revealed surfaces, not a cut painted onto a solid wall. Unlike the existing solid L-wall and straight single-face window, this opening continues around the actual corner; unlike a three-face display bay it has no intermediate corner mullions or enclosed display platform. Native metres, bounds-centred ground datum, one96triangle mesh and two opaque constant PBR materials. One architecture model, zero scenes. No glass, sash, door, host house, removable cutaway, structural reinforcement design, real beam capacity, building-code compliance, installation or safety assurance. The post-free corner is a fixed game-art shape, not a claim of safe real construction.
